description: Metaplay SDK Docs gives ChatGPT access to Metaplay's LLM-optimized documentation corpus, including SDK source files, sample projects, release notes, CLI reference, and website content across multiple SDK versions. Users can ask natural-language questions and the app retrieves the most relevant articles, reads specific files at requested line ranges, runs ripgrep regex searches, and globs for files by pattern.
